name: standardgalactic/agent-hivemind Claude Code Hook Injection

frameworkMappings.name: Event Triggered Execution: Unix Shell Configuration Modification

sigma.title: Claude Code Hook Directory Modification by Non-Claude Process
sigma.description: Detects file creation or modification in ~/.claude/hooks/ or ~/.claude/commands/ by any process other than the official claude binary. The standardgalactic/agent-hivemind MCP server (ClaudeOps) contains AgentDirectiveSystem which auto-installs pre-command.sh, post-command.sh, and ticket-sync.py hooks into these directories with auto_execute=True, priority=critical.
sigma.author: SocioProphet/SCOPE-D
falsepositives: Legitimate Claude Code extensions or plugins writing to these directories via official installer

github_actions_check.description: CI check: detect agent-hivemind or haivemind MCP server references in .claude/settings.json or mcp config files

osquery.description: Continuous monitoring — files in ~/.claude/hooks not owned by or written by claude binary
osquery.query: SELECT path, filename, mtime, atime, uid, gid FROM file WHERE path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude/hooks/%' OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude/commands/%' ORDER BY mtime DESC LIMIT 50;

expectedEffect: Alert fires when any non-claude process writes to ~/.claude/hooks/ or ~/.claude/commands/. This catches the AgentDirectiveSystem's auto-installation of pre-command.sh, post-command.sh, and ticket-sync.py hooks which would give the agent-hivemind server persistent execution on every Claude Code command.
falsePositiveRisk: LOW — legitimate hook modifications are rare and should always be operator-initiated. Any automated write to these directories is suspicious by default.
validationTestRefs: tests/test_mcp_authentication.py (from agent-hivemind — reference for what legitimate MCP auth looks like)
deploymentGate: Deploy immediately. This is a zero-day style persistence mechanism. No tuning period required — hook directory writes should always be human-initiated.
rollbackPlan: Remove alert if operator explicitly deploys a sanctioned hook framework with documented, approved hook files. Require change ticket with approval chain.
